description: Compute a round-robin fixture list (circle method) for 2-100 teams: every pair meets once, or twice home-and-away with second_leg; odd counts get one bye per round. Use when you need who plays whom in each round. Do NOT use to assign times/courts for one match day (use match_day_plan) or to get calendar dates for a season (use season_plan).

rounds.description: Optional: return only the first N rounds, integer 1..max (max = teams-1 for even counts, teams for odd; doubled with second_leg). Default: all rounds

second_leg.description: If true, append a mirrored second leg with home and away swapped (double round-robin). Default false

teams.description: Team names: 2-100 unique, non-empty names (trimmed), e.g. ["Falcons", "Tigers", "Bears"]

name: round_robin_schedule

games_per_team.description: Average games per team across the returned rounds (2 decimals)

legs.description: Number of legs included in the returned rounds (1 or 2)

note.description: Plain-English summary of the schedule (teams, rounds, byes, truncation)

rounds.description: Rounds in play order, each with its fixtures and any bye

items.description: A fixture {home, away}, or {bye} for the team sitting out this round

bye.description: Team with a bye (no game) this round

teams.description: Cleaned (trimmed) team names in input order

total_games.description: Total fixtures (excluding byes) in the returned rounds

title: Round robin schedule
